name: France National Quantum Strategy
description: France's National Quantum Strategy, part of the France 2030 investment plan, has committed €3.3 billion in total public quantum investment as of May 2026. The strategy covers quantum computing, simulators, sensors, post-quantum cryptography, and secure communication, and includes the PROQCIMA programme awarding up to €500 million to five companies building French-designed universal quantum computers by 2030.

news.title: France 2030: Progress Update - PROQCIMA Program Launched
news.excerpt: The launch of PROQCIMA was announced, which aims to have two prototypes of universal quantum computers of French design by 2030.

news.title: Quantum Priority Research and Equipment Programme (PEPR) Launched
news.excerpt: Ten selected projects were announced during the launch of the €150M Quantum Priority Research and Equipment Programme (PEPR).

news.title: Macron announces €1.55 billion additional investment in French quantum and semiconductor development
news.excerpt: President Macron announced an additional €1 billion for France's national quantum plan and €550 million for advanced semiconductor research, bringing France's total public quantum investment to €3.3 billion under France 2030.
